name: slot_rotated_90
why: The slot turned by 90 degrees on a plate wide enough to hold it in both directions: the volume does not change. By itself this check does not see the rotation -- it is «slot_on_narrow_plate_90» that sees it -- but it sees that rotating does not break the outline.

expect.tolerance_why: 480000 minus 535.0332 over 20: the calculation has pi inside
